matched_k0_requirement.construction_A_market_as_comparator: requires the arm own K0_MATCHED[arm_id] unchanged; the market column is at most a descriptive annotation on an already-adjudicated result; a market-covered subset is a different row set and therefore a different K0 record, not the same one restricted
matched_k0_requirement.construction_B_market_as_feature: makes the market a treatment_term, hence an arm, subject to exclusion minimality; CURRENTLY BARRED because the frozen packet excludes the market-odds family and admitting it would change the candidate universe
matched_k0_requirement.decision_time_pairing_requirement: a market observation and a model projection must be paired within the same decision-time label (vocabulary in use: T-24h, T-8h, T-30m) and the same cutoff, each with its own observation timestamp; no artifact on this branch pairs them

data_blockers.statement: No priced quantity corresponds to the primary target; the historical archive has no totals market.
The historical odds archive is not on this branch and is not tracked by git; future work on this track is not reproducible from player-model-program as it stands.

tip_times.csv discards odds_snapshot_timestamp, which is why every tip-time field is CUTOFF_UNPROVEN; D10 records the unprovenness as a property of the derivation, repairable only by a node with write scope over a source artifact.
The nine execution-side fields are capture-forward only; historical reconstruction is blocked by DL-002 at 27% T-24h coverage.
The prospective stream is not gradeable: coverage 0.3191, promotion_grade false.
The frozen availability table conflates observation span with event-date span on the market row (D11 C1).
Sub-day cutoff resolution is unverifiable in this wave (adversarial B7); a decision-time comparison is inherently sub-day.
The motivating soft-market premise is contradicted by a cited efficiency finding, and CLV is registered as an unresolved conflict while ROI optimisation is a standing no-go.

does_not_authorise_fitting_statement: This draft does NOT authorise fitting. Fitting requires a target contract (absent), a matched K0 (no K0_MATCHED[arm_id] record exists for any market-touching arm), cutoff-valid evidence (the market side is empty on this branch), a preregistration (none drafted) and an independent gate review (not this node's). None of the five is in this node's gift.

stop_conditions_restated_open.statement: The market-odds family was excluded on the ground that capture begins 2026-07-31; a game-joined historical archive with snapshots from 2022-05-21 exists. Not this node's decision. P2B_MARKET_ODDS_ELIGIBILITY is RUNNING and is contracted to adjudicate it.
A market feature changes what the model IS, from predicting possessions to predicting the market.

contradictions.statement: The frozen availability table's market row mixes an observation span with an event-date span (D11 C1). Restated, not re-derived; frozen, not edited.
The stated ground for excluding the market family is contradicted by an archive that exists (P29 SC1/X2). Frozen; adjudication belongs to P2B.
